headline: India's Andhra Pradesh High Court has let Adani's large data centre campus at Vizag keep being built, but warned the developer that it proceeds at its own risk.
score_reason: Pool score 5 kept: read through a second outlet; the ruling date is not stated and the report is second-hand.
importance_line: Residents and wildlife near Visakhapatnam, and the project's investors, face a live legal risk because a final ruling could undo approvals, though the court has not stopped construction and this account relies on secondary sourcing.
source: W.Media, citing The Times of India
summary: W.Media reports, citing The Times of India, that the court allowed Adani Infra's Vizag Hyperscale Data Centre Park Limited to keep building the AI-ready campus, part of Google's AI hub in India, while a public interest case challenging the state's approvals is still undecided. The court said money invested now cannot be used to seek relief if the approvals are later found improper, and W.Media notes three petitions to the National Green Tribunal that call the environmental assessment inadequate and point to a wildlife sanctuary less than a kilometre away.
notes: The pool item (ET Datacenters) returned no text, so the text was read at W.Media, which cites The Times of India; the Times of India article itself was not opened. Ruling date not stated.
